tasks.label: Debug a defect
tasks.description: Find and repair a concrete failing behavior.
tasks.validation: Reproduce the failure and run regression tests on the same repository.

tasks.label: Repository implementation
tasks.description: Implement a feature or migration spanning a repository.
patterns: codebase|repository|代码库|重构|迁移|跨文件
tasks.validation: Use the same repository, tests, tools, time budget and acceptance criteria.

tasks.label: Algorithmic coding
tasks.description: Solve bounded programming or competitive coding problems.
tasks.validation: Run hidden tests and adversarial complexity cases; do not reuse seen benchmark tasks.

tasks.label: Frontend implementation
tasks.description: Build interfaces from requirements or a visual reference.
tasks.validation: Render at multiple sizes; compare fidelity, accessibility and interaction behavior.

tasks.label: Defensive code review
tasks.description: Find and fix vulnerabilities in authorized code.
patterns: vulnerabilit|security review|安全审计|漏洞|防御
tasks.validation: Use a safe local reproduction and verify the patch without breaking behavior.

tasks.label: System design
tasks.description: Evaluate architecture and system tradeoffs.
tasks.validation: Score assumptions, tradeoffs, failure modes and requirements coverage.

tasks.label: Terminal agent
tasks.description: Complete a task in a shell or development environment.
tasks.validation: Match shell access, package state and agent harness; verify the resulting artifact.

tasks.label: Test design
tasks.description: Design tests that expose meaningful failures.
patterns: unit test|test suite|测试用例|单元测试|测试策略
tasks.validation: Measure faults detected and false positives, not test count.

tasks.label: Competition mathematics
tasks.description: Solve a well-posed contest problem.
patterns: olympiad|aime|竞赛数学|奥数|数学竞赛
tasks.validation: Blind-grade solutions for correctness and reasoning with a fresh problem set.

tasks.label: Mathematical proof
tasks.description: Develop or check a rigorous mathematical argument.
tasks.validation: Check each inference; use a formal checker when a formal proof is requested.

tasks.label: Formal proof code
tasks.description: Write machine-checkable Lean, Coq or Isabelle proofs.
tasks.validation: Compile with the exact prover and library versions; reject sorry/admit.

tasks.label: Numerical reasoning
tasks.description: Derive or compute a numerical result.
patterns: numerical|integral|微分|积分|数值计算|线性代数
tasks.validation: Compare to a numerical or symbolic reference and inspect stability and units.

tasks.label: Financial filing research
tasks.description: Find and reconcile information in company filings.
tasks.validation: Check citations, accounting periods, units and every intermediate value.

tasks.label: Valuation model
tasks.description: Build a financial valuation with assumptions.
tasks.validation: Audit formula links, assumptions, scenarios and financial conventions.

tasks.label: Backtest audit
tasks.description: Implement or critique an investment backtest.
patterns: backtest|look.?ahead|回测|未来函数|幸存者偏差
tasks.validation: Test for look-ahead, survivorship bias, costs, splits and out-of-sample leakage.

tasks.label: Factor research
tasks.description: Evaluate factors or portfolio construction.
patterns: alpha factor|portfolio optim|因子|量化|组合优化
tasks.validation: Use held-out periods and realistic costs; no benchmark proves alpha.

tasks.label: Derivative pricing
tasks.description: Reason about derivatives, stochastic models and risk.
patterns: derivative pricing|black.scholes|期权|衍生品|随机微积分
tasks.validation: Check derivation, units, limiting cases and simulation against a trusted reference.

tasks.label: Scientific problem solving
tasks.description: Solve a scientific question with explicit assumptions.
patterns: physics|chemistry|biolog|物理|化学|生物|科研问题
tasks.validation: Have a domain expert check assumptions, units, evidence and reproducibility.

tasks.label: Scientific computing
tasks.description: Implement or reproduce a computational experiment.
patterns: scientific comput|simulation|复现实验|科学计算|仿真
tasks.validation: Reproduce a known result with fixed environment, data and seeds.

tasks.label: Literature synthesis
tasks.description: Synthesize research papers and compare findings.
patterns: literature review|papers|文献|论文综述|研究综述
tasks.validation: Verify cited papers and assess study quality, disagreement and coverage.

tasks.label: Hypothesis generation
tasks.description: Generate testable research hypotheses.
patterns: hypothes|研究假设|科学发现|实验设计
tasks.validation: Score falsifiability, novelty relative to literature and executable controls.

tasks.label: Creative writing
tasks.description: Write fiction, poetry or dialogue in a chosen voice.
tasks.validation: Blind-compare samples in the target language using the user’s style rubric.

tasks.label: Editing and rewriting
tasks.description: Improve wording while preserving intended meaning.
tasks.validation: Compare meaning preservation, voice, factual consistency and brevity.

tasks.label: Professional document
tasks.description: Draft a clear memo, report or business document.
patterns: memo|business report|proposal|报告|方案|商业计划
tasks.validation: Evaluate decision usefulness, completeness, factual accuracy and audience fit.

tasks.label: Translation and localization
tasks.description: Translate with terminology and cultural context.
tasks.validation: Use bilingual review of terminology, meaning, style and omissions.

tasks.label: Evidence retrieval
tasks.description: Locate exact evidence in a large supplied corpus.
patterns: find.*document|检索|定位.*证据|查找.*原文
tasks.validation: Plant known facts across the corpus and check source locations and distractors.

tasks.label: Long-document synthesis
tasks.description: Combine and reconcile many long documents.
patterns: long.context|long document|长上下文|长文|几十万|百万.*token|多份文档
tasks.validation: Test cross-document contradictions and middle-of-context recall at actual input size.

tasks.label: Summarization
tasks.description: Summarize supplied content without inventing facts.
tasks.validation: Compare coverage, omissions and unsupported claims against the source.

tasks.label: Business workflow agent
tasks.description: Execute a multi-step workflow across tools.
patterns: workflow|tool.call|工作流|工具调用|自动化流程
tasks.validation: Use identical tool schemas and permissions; verify final state and recovery.

tasks.label: GUI agent
tasks.description: Interact with desktop or browser interfaces.
patterns: computer use|browser agent|浏览器操作|桌面操作|点击.*按钮
tasks.validation: Evaluate end-state correctness in a sandbox with the same UI and action budget.

tasks.label: Long-running agent
tasks.description: Carry out an extended task with state and recovery.
patterns: long.running|long.horizon|多步骤|长期任务|长程|自主执行
tasks.validation: Measure completion, recovery, context retention and human interventions.

tasks.label: Chart interpretation
tasks.description: Extract and reason about visual charts.
tasks.validation: Check values, labels, scales and conclusions against underlying data.

tasks.label: Document OCR and layout
tasks.description: Read scanned documents or complex page layouts.
tasks.validation: Measure text, table-cell and reading-order accuracy on representative pages.

tasks.label: Video understanding
tasks.description: Understand events across time in a video.
tasks.validation: Use event timestamps and temporal questions; verify upload and frame limits.

tasks.label: Visual and spatial reasoning
tasks.description: Reason about spatial relationships in images.
patterns: spatial|几何图|空间关系|看图|图片
tasks.validation: Use novel images and check coordinates, relations and grounding.

tasks.label: Deep web research
tasks.description: Search, reconcile and cite evidence from the web.
patterns: deep research|web research|深度研究|联网调研|调查报告
tasks.validation: Audit source diversity, citation entailment, completeness and date relevance.

tasks.label: Fact checking
tasks.description: Verify a factual claim against trustworthy sources.
tasks.validation: Trace each claim to a primary source and report unresolved conflicts.

tasks.label: Data analysis
tasks.description: Analyze tabular data and explain findings.
patterns: data analy|统计分析|数据分析|回归分析
tasks.validation: Run the calculations and inspect missingness, assumptions and uncertainty.

tasks.label: SQL generation
tasks.description: Translate data questions into database queries.
tasks.validation: Execute against a sandbox with schema constraints and hidden test cases.

tasks.label: Structured extraction
tasks.description: Extract fields into a schema.
tasks.validation: Measure field precision/recall and schema validity with adversarial inputs.

tasks.label: Spreadsheet modeling
tasks.description: Edit or reason about workbook formulas and structure.
tasks.validation: Recalculate, verify formulas and inspect rendered sheets and dependency links.

tasks.label: Audio understanding
tasks.description: Transcribe or understand supplied audio.
tasks.validation: Measure word errors, speaker attribution and timestamps in the target language.

tasks.label: Tutoring and explanation
tasks.description: Explain a concept at the learner’s level.
patterns: teach me|explain|教学|教我|解释|讲解
tasks.validation: Check conceptual accuracy, level fit and transfer to a new practice problem.

tasks.label: Legal research
tasks.description: Research legal questions with jurisdiction and date.
tasks.validation: Check jurisdiction, current authority and citation entailment with expert review.

tasks.label: Medical information
tasks.description: Find and explain medical information.
tasks.validation: Verify current clinical sources and distinguish information from individual diagnosis.

tasks.label: Everyday assistance
tasks.description: A simple question or an intent outside the current taxonomy.
tasks.validation: Use the current capable model; check whether the result satisfies the user.

tasks.label: Database schema design
tasks.description: Design relational schemas, constraints and migrations.
patterns: database schema|schema design|数据库设计|表结构|数据建模
tasks.validation: Apply migrations to a disposable database and verify constraints, indices, transactions and seed idempotence.

tasks.label: Generative visual web design
tasks.description: Create an original landing page or visual interactive prototype; distinguish visual appeal from production correctness.
patterns: landing page|落地页|视觉设计|创意网页
tasks.validation: Render the same brief at mobile and desktop sizes; inspect visual coherence, accessibility and working interactions.

tasks.label: Reference-to-code fidelity
tasks.description: Reproduce a supplied screenshot or design specification accurately.
tasks.validation: Compare rendered screenshots at specified viewports and test interaction/accessibility; do not substitute generic aesthetic preference.
